description: This file implements a logging utility for the HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) in C++, providing functions to log messages at various levels, initialize and terminate logging modules, and manage verbose logging settings based on environment variables or presence of specific files.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_Logger_Message(eMessageLevel level,const char * function,int line,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified level, function name, and line number, formatting variable arguments into a message string.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_LogModuleInit()
methods.description: Initializes the logging module, checks environment variables and files to set verbose logging.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_LogModuleTerminate()
methods.description: Terminates the logging module, logs termination message.
